title: Harbison Protection Contracts Fee Schedule: Claim Service Fee, Transfer and Cancellation Terms
content:
This schedule lists the per-visit claim service fee and the transfer and cancellation terms of each Harbison Protection Contracts tier. Amounts are in US dollars and day counts are calendar days.

**Claim service fee.** The service fee the holder pays per visit on which a claim is approved; $0.00 means none.

| Tier | Claim service fee |
|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | $0.00 (none) |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | $75.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | $75.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | $50.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | $0.00 (none) |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | $0.00 (none) |

**Transfer to the buyer of the home.**

| Tier | Transfer allowed | Transfer window after the sale closes | Transfer fee on the buyer's contract | Transfers allowed over the contract's life |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | yes | 30 days | $0.00 (none) | 1 |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | yes | 30 days | $50.00 | 1 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | yes | 30 days | $50.00 | 1 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | yes | 60 days | $75.00 | 1 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | 60 days | $75.00 | 2 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | 60 days | $75.00 | 2 |

**Cancellation by the holder.**

| Tier | Cancellation for a refund allowed | Full-refund days after purchase | Administrative fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | no | 0 (not allowed) | $0.00 |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | yes | 60 days | $50.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | yes | 60 days | $50.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | yes | 60 days | $50.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | 60 days | $75.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | 60 days | $75.00 |

- *Full-refund days*: calendar days after purchase within which a cancellation with no claims paid is refunded in full; 0 where cancellation is not allowed.
- *Administrative fee*: the fee deducted from a pro-rata cancellation refund.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A contract on the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection may pass to a buyer, and from that buyer to a later buyer, because the tier allows 2 transfers; a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection contract may pass once.
